purpose: Statistically test agreement with historical NASA DR25 KOI CANDIDATE/FALSE POSITIVE Robovetter labels, comparing existing four-feature random forest against SNR-only and a new conventional logistic baseline. This is NOT planet confirmation, survey sensitivity, or an independent mission vetting comparison.

source.known_information: Prior 11/06 report included 8,054 labeled KOIs on 6,923 stars. This dataset has been previously inspected; new multi-split analysis is a robustness exercise, not a newly untouched independent trial.

truth: koi_pdisposition mapped CANDIDATE=1, FALSE POSITIVE=0: NASA historical labels, not physical verified planet state.

heldout.selection: ml_screening.split_by_star GroupShuffleSplit: 20% distinct-star test, then validation 25% of remaining; train/val/test hosts disjoint in each split.
heldout.caveat: Repeated splits reuse data previously explored by the project, and are sensitivity to star composition not independent confirmations.

methods.snr: Existing log1p(SNR) score with training-median imputation, validation-set threshold only.
methods.random_forest: Existing sklearn pipeline: median imputer, RandomForestClassifier 120 trees, max_depth=9, min_samples_leaf=3, random_state=split_seed, n_jobs=-1.
methods.logistic: Median-impute log1p all four features, StandardScaler, LogisticRegression(max_iter=2000, solver=lbfgs, C=1, class_weight=None, random_state=split_seed). No grid search.

decision.threshold: Fixed original ml_screening.cutoff(scores, validation_labels, desired=0.9). No test label tuning and no forced threshold change to equalize achieved test recall.
decision.threshold_caution: Equal validation recall target does NOT ensure equal heldout test recall. Report achieved recall differences and false-positive-rate tradeoff.

primary_endpoint: Difference in balanced accuracy on primary held-out split: RandomForest minus SNR (label agreement, not planet detection). Balanced accuracy = (historical candidate recall + historical false-positive specificity)/2.
secondary_endpoints: Primary split random forest versus logistic balanced accuracy.
Primary split paired overall accuracy and host-clustered error differences.
Primary split achieved recall and FPR of all methods.
ROC AUC of continuous scores (threshold-independent), cluster bootstrap CI for random forest minus SNR and logistic.
Differences in false-negative candidate dismissals and false-positive acceptance; do not suppress worse recall.
Across nine other grouped-by-star splits: median, min, max and percentage points for differences; repeated splits are dependent and cannot be pooled for p-value.

statistical_tests.primary: Two-sided host-level method-swap permutation for difference in balanced accuracy at primary split. Under null of exchangeable paired classifier correctness by host, random sign-flip each entire host's weighted BA contribution; seed and iteration counts fixed.
statistical_tests.multiple_comparisons: Only RandomForest minus SNR on primary split in balanced accuracy is confirmatory within this re-analysis, conditional on source and predeclared model/training split. All other tests descriptive/exploratory. Since source data and primary split have been inspected previously, this is not an untouched confirmatory discovery study.
statistical_tests.ci: Star-level paired bootstrap percentile 95% CI, preserving multiple KOIs per star.
statistical_tests.mcnemar: Exact discordant-pair McNemar p on KOIs is reported as a naive supplemental check but not preferred over host-aware inference, since signals can share hosts.
statistical_tests.bootstrap_p_warning: Do not convert percentile bootstrap sign frequencies into nominal p-values.
